newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: King Hussein urges complementary EU peace role.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein urges complementary EU peace role.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan said on Wednesday the United States remained the key player in Arab-Israeli mediation, but the European Union should perform a complementary role in the Middle East peace process.
"The United States would hopefully contribute more if Europe stood by the United States in a complementary fashion," he told a news conference after meeting Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok.
Hussein also commended the Netherlands, which currently holds the six-month rotating EU presidency, for its "principled stands and its search for peace".
Kok said the Netherlands favoured a two-pronged strategy in the Middle East, aimed at both promoting peace and addressing social and economic problems in the area.
"The one must be done in conjunction with the other," he said.
Kok added that he had discussed the Middle East peace process in depth with U.S. President Clinton when the latter visited the Netherlands last month.
"We are at a difficult time (in the process). Informal contacts can be very useful and Jordanian-Dutch relations are developing in a very useful way," he said.
King Hussein is on a tour of Europe which also includes visits to France and Switzerland.
